applicableAreas: Proposed driveways along western boundary (Valley View Road right-of-way)
findings.comment: Two proposed driveways cross overhead electric lines in the Valley View Road right-of-way. Site plan shows OHE line crossing directly over both driveway aprons, but no vertical clearance dimensions are provided from the lowest point of the overhead conductors to the finished driveway surface. Minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (for parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (for areas with truck traffic) required per UCM § 1.10.6.2, but cannot be verified from available plans.

applicableAreas: Driveways beneath overhead electric lines on western boundary
findings.comment: No survey data from a registered surveyor provided showing pole locations and mid-span clearances from overhead electric conductors to finished driveway grades. When existing overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements, registered surveyor mid-span clearance data is required per UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: General site - entire property with overhead electric infrastructure
findings.comment: Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines. This notification requirement must be prominently noted on the cover sheet per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003, as referenced in UCM § 1.10.2.

applicableAreas: Street yard and parking lot landscaping areas along western boundary where overhead distribution conductors are present
findings.comment: Proposed trees are shown on the landscape plan along the western boundary within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors. The specific species of these proposed trees are not identified on the plans (labeled only as 'SYM' with no species key provided). Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors must be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list (ECM Appendix F, species generally with mature height ≤20 feet marked 'UC'). Utility-compatible species status cannot be verified from available landscape documentation.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1 and 8 (closest to western boundary with overhead lines)
findings.comment: No surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors are included on building elevation sheets to demonstrate that required clearances are met. Building elevation sheets showing surveyed conductor elevation data with clearance dimension annotations are required per UCM § 1.10.3 when buildings are proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities. Building elevations are not provided in this site plan submittal.

applicableAreas: Proposed buildings and site features near overhead electric lines on western boundary
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings, building projections, or other site features for clearance verification. Dimension lines with clearance measurements from outside conductor (not pole centerline) to all building features are required per UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric line clearance zones throughout site
findings.comment: Although overhead electric lines are shown on site plans, clearance dimensions (where provided) cannot be verified as being measured from the outside conductor rather than from pole centerline or pole structure. On multi-conductor installations, the outside conductor may be several feet offset from pole center. Dimension annotations must clearly show that measurements originate from outside conductor per UCM § 1.10.3 and NESC Section 234.
